Email.//: SendGrid sends when SendGrid:ApiKey is set; empty (locally) = emails are written to the console instead.

SMS.//: Twilio sends when its settings are set; empty (locally) = texts, with the code, are written to the console: use it to confirm a mobile number locally.

Captcha.//: Turnstile on the sign-up and sign-in pages. Required: empty, the bjk-core setup puts in Cloudflare's public test keys, which pass every check.

SignUp.//: UK-only sign-up. Deployed, the country comes from Cloudflare's CF-IPCountry header. DevelopmentCountry is local only: e.g. FR to see the refusal; empty = allowed.

AgeAssurance.//: The on-demand age check for sensitive posts: liveness, then Yoti's face estimate, with photo ID as the fallback. A real check runs when its settings are set; otherwise the stand-ins in Development answer below. ChallengeAge: estimated age that passes without photo ID. MaxAttemptsPerDay: selfie or ID attempts per 24 hours. MaxVideoBytes / MaxImageBytes: upload limits (15 MB, 10 MB).

Liveness.//: The real head-turn check (YuNet), on when ModelPath is set; the bjk-core setup downloads the model and sets it. Frames are sampled at FramesPerSecond for up to MaxSeconds; a face must be in MinFaceFrameRatio of frames (at least MinFaceFrames), at least MinFaceWidthRatio of the width, and turn past YawThreshold each way. The rest are the defaults.

Yoti.//: Yoti's face age estimate (with Yoti's anti-spoofing), on when SdkId and PrivateKey (secret: the whole PEM text) are set, from the Yoti Hub. Empty locally: the stand-in answers. BaseUrl: Yoti's sandbox for DEV and QA, live for Staging and Live. Above MaxUncertainty years' margin the result counts as 'couldn't tell' (photo ID offered).

Development.//: Local only: what the stand-ins answer. EstimatedAge 20 = photo ID needed, 15 = under 18, 0 = can't tell. DocumentAge 16 = ID says under 18. LivenessPasses is used only without a liveness model.

Support.//: Where people ask for help, e.g. the 'Contact support' link after a failed age check (a mailto link until a ticketing system replaces it).

DataProtection.//: Leave Certificate empty locally (keys stored unencrypted, with a warning in the log). Required outside Development: a PFX certificate with its private key, as base64 (see Encryption in the README).

Admin.//: Once you've registered and confirmed your email, put it here to become the first admin.
